messages:
diane: Kicking off quota request for asia-southeast1 cluster bring‑up. Need 48 A100 80GB (or compatible) reserved for the initial test week and 200x T4 preemptible for worker pools. Filing to cloud with a 2-week lead. Who's owning followups?

sam: Can you paste target availability zones? We should split across 2 AZs to avoid single‑AZ outages. Also do we want dedicated reservations or a capacity commitment? Dedicated reservation preferred for predictable latency.

leo: For bring-up we usually request a 30-day reservation with auto‑renew option. Steps: 1) submit quota increase 2) open committed use/Reservation ticket 3) confirm billing approval 4) validate in infra. I'll start the quota ticket now.

maya: Cost note: 48x A100-80 ongoing for a week is ~$35k estimate (rough). Could we start with 24 reserved + burst pool to reduce spend and bump to 48 after smoke tests? Also propose a fallback of 8xA100 + 64xT4 for staging.

diane: Good call. Plan: request 24 reserved A100-80 in 2 AZs (12/12) + ability to scale to 48 via quota/temporary reservations. Request T4 quota bumped to 300 preemptible. I'll include the cost estimate and the go/no-go thresholds.

sam: FYI, cloud provider will ask for project billing contact — @maya can you confirm billing owner?

maya: I'm on it. Billing contact set to infra-billing@redwood.com.

infra-bot: Ticket #INC-5783 created with cloud provider: Quota increase request (asia-southeast1) — link: https://cloud.vendor/tickets/INC-5783

leo: Adding validation checklist:
- verify quotas in console
- provision one test node for each AZ
- run kernel + nv_peer_mem tests
- run throughput smoke with 2 replicas

diane: Handoff: once quotas are approved, infra team will provision reservations, then assign to staging cluster. @sam @leo will own validation; @maya will approve billing. We'll reconvene when quota is approved. :thumbsup:
